data:
SolidCraft Forge exposes the scpf Python authoring API under cadlib/src/scpf/.
The NEW repository is migrating product documentation from the historical Forge repository onto Hugo/Hextra. Repository architecture and migration status live under docs/; generated API, guides and reference content will be migrated after the package/bootstrap baseline is accepted.
Public CAD models and their published multi-engine qualification evidence.
A rectangular plate with one TOP-face hole source that is cut once and repeated as an editable native rectangular pattern.
